status: frozen: version 2, accepted by the owner on 2026-11-13. Questions are not edited; a mistake is fixed by a new version.
changes: Version 2 (2026-11-13, owner): 6–8 redrawn evenly by grade (G68-01 to G68-38 rewritten); the two grade-8 natural-set topics stay in 6–8; the hand-picked 9–12 topics are accepted.
use: The fixed measure for M1 (coverage), and the source of the M2/M3 regression sample. Never used to tune a prompt, a recipe or a card; probes and tests use their own cases.
Once frozen, questions are not edited. A mistake is fixed by a new version, with the change and its reason recorded here.

teacher_picture says what a good teacher would draw, judged without regard to what components exist; picture_kind is that picture's generic kind. Whether a component can draw it (fully, partly, not) is M1 and is recorded with the M1 results, not here.
held_out: held_out questions are never quoted in a design discussion, decision record, probe, test or prompt, and are never read when designing a component. They are only read when M1 is tagged and when a paid M2/M3 run is read, and their results are reported separately as a check that the rest of the set was not fitted to.
method: Counts per band are the plan's: K–2 30, 3–5 40, 6–8 40, 9–12 50.

K–8: star-map catalog topics (octos-learn services/learning-history/taxonomy/catalog.json), banded by the US grade of the topic's middle age (age − 5.5). Each band's count (K–2, 3–5) is split over its domains in proportion to the catalog, at least one per domain; topics, language and phrasing kind are drawn by seed in scripts/draw-math-question-set.mjs (seed 20261113). The question is then written for the drawn topic.

6–8 (version 2, owner 2026-11-13): the catalog's 6–8 topics are mostly grade 6, so the band is drawn evenly by grade (grade 6: 12, 7: 13, 8: 13, by the topic's middle age) from its own seed stream (seed 20261113 + 68), each grade split over its domains as above. Version 1 drew 6–8 like the other bands; its 6–8 questions are replaced. The other bands' draws are unchanged.
Catalog used: octos-learn commit f6ccb640 (the catalog's last change; file SHA-256 prefix 2c4803c89d060197). A changed catalog draws different topics.

9–12: the plan's six domains with counts fixed before writing (Number & Quantity 5, Algebra 9, Functions 9, Geometry 8, Statistics & Probability 6, Precalculus & Calculus 3); phrasing kind drawn by seed; topics chosen by hand within each domain.

Natural-input set: one case per topic from math-natural-course-cases.json, variants rotating detailed/question/topic, copied verbatim (source natural-set). Its 12 topics were used in earlier quality work, so they are never held out and M1 is reported with and without them. Two (linear systems, Pythagoras) are grade-8 topics in the US and sit in 6–8.
Held-out: after writing, a quarter of each band (rounded) is drawn by seed from the questions that are not natural-set.
Standard codes are not cited: none have been looked up.
departures: K2-16, K2-18: the drawn topics (choosing a strategy, justifying reasoning) describe work above K–2; the questions are written at K–2 level.
G35-23: the drawn topic is precise vocabulary across many areas; the question asks about one pair of terms (radius and diameter).
G35-40: the drawn topic is unequal sharing and grouping with fractions; the question is an equal-sharing problem whose answer is a fraction.

kinds.question: a short question as a learner asks it
kinds.detailed: a longer request saying what the lesson should show

picture_kinds.number_line: positions, jumps or intervals on one axis
picture_kinds.coordinate_graph: points, lines or curves on coordinate axes
picture_kinds.solid_3d: 3D solids or surfaces, turned or cut
picture_kinds.area_model: rectangles of unit squares or of labelled parts (arrays, area products)
picture_kinds.part_whole_model: bars, circles or grids divided into parts (fractions, tape diagrams)
picture_kinds.objects_and_groups: countable objects, ten frames, groups and patterns of objects
picture_kinds.place_value_model: base-ten blocks or a place-value chart
picture_kinds.data_chart: tallies, picture/bar graphs, dot plots, box plots, histograms, scatter plots, distributions
picture_kinds.probability_model: spinners, sample spaces and probability trees
picture_kinds.balance_model: a balance showing two equal sides
picture_kinds.table: a table of values or a two-way table
picture_kinds.written_method: a written calculation laid out in columns or steps
picture_kinds.none: no visual needed: words and formulas teach it
